'''Large Milk''' is an [[:Category:Animal Products|animal product]] obtained from a [[Cow]] with sufficient [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]] and [[Animals#Mood|mood]]. It can also randomly rotate into the [[Traveling Cart]]'s stock for {{Tprice|190}}.

==Bundles==
*Large Milk is an option for the {{Bundle|Animal||y}}.
*Ten Milk (any size, including [[Goat Milk]] and [[Large Goat Milk]]) are used in the {{Bundle|home cook||y}}.

==Artisan Goods==
:''See also: [[Animal Products Profitability]]''
Large Milk can be used to make the following [[Artisan Goods]].  Note that regular [[Milk]] always produces regular quality [[Cheese]], while Large Milk always produces gold-quality [[Cheese]].  The quality of the Milk is not a factor.

Cheese may be aged in [[Cask]]s to increase its quality.

==Tailoring==
Large Milk is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt217.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Sleeveless Overalls]].

==Quests==
Large Milk is not used in any [[quests]].
